items.title: Ship the Falsification Episode (hand-built 1080p30 thin slice) and publish it before any 4K60 render work
items.acceptance_criteria: One 10-14 min episode assembled by hand from a hand-authored DataBrief (one indicator, ~40 countries), a single static-slide template at 1080p30, TTS narration with a -14 LUFS master, QC pass and 3 thumbnails, published public on the flagship channel. A 14-day read is recorded as views/video/day in SQLite. Go/no-go: >=20 views/video/day keeps the format and unblocks REN-02; below 10 kills the topic shape before any 4K60 work is spent on it.

items.title: Provision Hetzner CPX41 control plane + on-demand RTX 4090 worker within ~$100/mo budget
items.acceptance_criteria: CPX41 reachable over SSH with the cron/SQLite/FastMCP stack installed; an on-demand RTX 4090 worker provisions and destroys cleanly via API for a 2-hour render window; >=200GB NVMe free.

items.title: Install Python 3.11+, CUDA Toolkit, FFmpeg with NVENC (hevc_nvenc/h264_nvenc), and ManimGL/Cairo deps
items.acceptance_criteria: ffmpeg -encoders shows h264_nvenc and hevc_nvenc; test 4K60 5-second GPU encode completes in <3 seconds.

items.title: Initialize Python project skeleton, pyproject.toml, .env secrets template, and logging config
items.acceptance_criteria: Virtual environment builds cleanly; structured JSON logging writes to logs/ with secrets loaded strictly from .env.

items.title: Configure Cloudflare R2 (or Backblaze B2) archive sync & NVMe auto-pruning policy
items.acceptance_criteria: Published masters and SQLite/JSON snapshots sync to R2; local scratch scene cache auto-cleans after 7 days.

items.title: Set up API spend guardrails & monthly cost telemetry (Claude API + GPU runtime + R2)
items.acceptance_criteria: Hard Anthropic monthly spend cap set; daily cost summary logged to SQLite and sent via Telegram if >$4/day.

items.title: Design SQLite warehouse schema (data/schema.sql: dim_countries, fact_observations, episode_snapshots, rss_items, videos, ats_snapshots, hijack_attempts, hijack_results)
items.acceptance_criteria: `sqlite3 data/production.db < data/schema.sql` initializes idempotently in WAL mode with 217 ISO-3 countries, regions, currencies, flag paths and GeoJSON IDs.

items.title: Build World Bank API v2 connector with pagination, retry backoff, and indicator caching
items.acceptance_criteria: Fetches full multi-decade history for NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD and writes clean rows to fact_observations in <10s. Connector tests replay recorded fixtures (DAT-09) rather than calling api.worldbank.org.

items.title: Build FRED API connector for US/global macro, CPI, wages, housing, and interest rates
items.acceptance_criteria: Fetches FRED series with metadata units and frequency normalization into SQLite.

items.title: Build OECD SDMX API connector for Tier-1 average wages, tax wedge, and hours worked
items.acceptance_criteria: Successfully parses OECD SDMX JSON/CSV payloads and maps all OECD members to ISO-3 codes.

items.title: Build DBnomics, UN Data, IMF and Our World in Data (OWID) secondary connectors
items.acceptance_criteria: Ingests IMF debt-to-GDP / inflation forecasts and OWID long-run historical CSVs into unified schema.

items.title: Build Data Normalizer (ISO-3 reconciliation, PPP vs Nominal tagging, missing-year handling)
items.acceptance_criteria: Zero orphan country names; explicitly flags latest available year per country and rejects unaligned units.

items.title: Build Deterministic Statistical Analyzer & DataBrief JSON + Fact-ID Ledger generator
items.acceptance_criteria: Generates a frozen episode snapshot (JSON row-set keyed by episode_id) + DataBrief JSON with Top/Bottom N, medians, CAGRs, outliers, and F001..Fxxx IDs.

items.title: Build FastMCP data-grounding server (get_indicator, rank_countries, get_series, search_datasets)
items.acceptance_criteria: Claude can call the MCP tools over stdio, receives only warehouse-backed rows with Fact IDs, and never receives a number that is absent from fact_observations.

items.title: Build the record/replay HTTP fixture harness so every connector test runs offline
items.acceptance_criteria: A cassette layer records each provider response once into tests/fixtures/<provider>/ and replays it afterwards; the whole connector suite passes with outbound network disabled, which is what AGENTS.md section 5 requires and what 7 live providers otherwise make impossible.

items.title: Create Editorial Queue DB & seed initial 30-Video Launch Slate mapped to real API indicators
items.acceptance_criteria: 30 topics stored with status, target indicator codes, query-shaped title candidates and thumbnail concepts, seeded as 6 pillars x 5 episodes from the DECISIONS.md D-03 slate: no format-label titles, no two episodes sharing a thesis, and every title a query a person would type.

items.title: Build YouTube Autocomplete & Outlier Competitor Video Miner
items.acceptance_criteria: Discovers high views-to-subscriber outlier videos in economics/rankings niche and extracts title patterns.

items.title: Implement automated Topic Scorer (Tier-1 demand, CPM weight, data completeness, curiosity gap)
items.acceptance_criteria: Ranks candidate topics 0-100 and auto-promotes top-scoring unused topics into the daily pipeline queue.

items.title: Build the pre-production demand gate: stale-result test and query-volume rubric recorded per episode
items.acceptance_criteria: Every queued episode carries a recorded demand verdict before the ETL stage: the top-3 competitor results for the exact query, their age in years, and their views/day (the stale-result score, VIEW_OPTIMIZATION section 2.2). An episode with no query volume or with recent top results is refused by the queue instead of being produced. Ten minutes of research per episode; this is the only mechanism that removes no-demand videos before they dilute views/video/day (DECISIONS.md D-10).

items.title: Define Pydantic SceneGraph JSON Schema (acts, scenes, visual templates, data bindings, SFX cues)
items.acceptance_criteria: Schema validates 10-18 min episodes, enforces visual-template entropy (no consecutive duplicates), and links every scene to fact IDs. The schema carries an explicit schema_version and the prompt_version that produced it, so a later model or prompt change can be re-audited against the episodes it already made.

items.title: Engineer versioned front-tier-model prompts with prompt caching and a registry fallback
items.acceptance_criteria: Generates 1,700-2,600 word causal documentary scripts + SceneGraph JSON at a cost of <=$0.30/script with cache hit rate >70%, resolving the model through config/models.yaml and falling back to the registry's alternate provider on repeated fact-audit failure (DECISIONS.md D-07: a retired model is a config edit, not a release).

items.title: Build Zero-Hallucination Automated Fact-Audit Gate & targeted auto-repair loop
items.acceptance_criteria: Extracts every number/rank/percentage in narration, cross-checks against DataBrief (+-0.5% tolerance), and auto-repairs mismatches.

items.title: Add Retention Pacing Linter (0-35s hook, open loops, pattern interrupts every <=55s, end-screen bridge)
items.acceptance_criteria: Scores script retention structure and rejects scripts lacking a hook contrast, mid-video inversion, or bridge.

items.title: Deploy local GPU TTS (MeloTTS primary, Kokoro-82M alternate, Azure Neural fallback) with a locked narrator voice
items.acceptance_criteria: MeloTTS synthesizes clean 48kHz broadcast narration per scene at >10x real-time with $0 marginal API cost; Azure fallback triggers on any flagged pronunciation.

items.title: Build Pronunciation Lexicon & SSML/Pause Preprocessor for countries, currencies, and acronyms
items.acceptance_criteria: Correctly pronounces 100+ tricky terms (Gini, PPP, OECD, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, CHF, UAE, etc.) with natural pauses.

items.title: Integrate WhisperX / stable-ts Forced Word-Level Alignment
items.acceptance_criteria: Outputs per-scene word timestamp JSON (start_ms, end_ms) accurate within +-40ms to drive visual animation triggers.

items.title: Curate royalty-free ambient documentary BGM stems & micro-SFX library with license manifest
items.acceptance_criteria: At least 6 loopable BGM tracks + 15 crisp SFX stored in assets/ with documented commercial licenses in assets/licenses.json.

items.title: Build FFmpeg Audio Mixer (sidechain BGM ducking, timestamped SFX injection, 2-pass -14 LUFS mastering)
items.acceptance_criteria: Master audio hits -14.0 +- 0.5 LUFS, <= -1.0 dBTP true peak, smooth BGM ducking, and exact frame-synced SFX hits.

items.title: Establish 4K 60FPS Documentary Visual Design System (palette, typography, safe margins, source footer)
items.acceptance_criteria: style_guide.yaml + font/flag/Natural Earth GeoJSON asset pack verified legible at both 4K TV and 360px mobile sizes. It also publishes the single `RenderSpec` Pydantic contract (scene_id, template, data bindings, camera move, safe zones, SFX cues, duration) plus one golden fixture, so all 8 templates bind data the same way instead of embedding their own binding logic.

items.title: Build the 1440p60-first render engine (atomic scene worker pool + static texture cache + NVENC pipe)
items.acceptance_criteria: Streams raw 2560x1440 60fps RGB frames directly to hevc_nvenc/h264_nvenc with zero intermediate PNG bloat; benchmark >=25fps. The same pipeline renders 4K60 through REN-10's preset, so this item changes resolution, not architecture (DECISIONS.md D-12: 2.2x the pixels for a difference a mobile viewer cannot resolve, held until YPP).

items.title: Implement Template 1: BarChartRace (interpolated rankings, flags, rolling year counter, spotlight glow)
items.acceptance_criteria: Renders buttery-smooth 4K60 Top-15 bar race synchronized to WhisperX word highlights.

items.title: Implement Template 2: WorldChoroplethMap (Natural Earth vectors, camera zoom/pan, animated color scale)
items.acceptance_criteria: Renders crisp vector world map with smooth zoom onto target regions and animated country callout pins.

items.title: Implement Template 3: SpotlightCountryCard & Template 4: ChapterTitleCard
items.acceptance_criteria: High-contrast KPI card with animated rolling counters, sparkline, rank badge, plus 3-second kinetic chapter transition.

items.title: Implement Template 5: DualSplitComparison (e.g., Nominal vs PPP or Country A vs Country B)
items.acceptance_criteria: Animated split-screen comparison with synced delta callout and zero label overlap.

items.title: Implement Template 6: HistoricalLineRace & Template 7: AnimatedBubbleScatter
items.acceptance_criteria: Multi-line time series with historical event pins + multi-axis animated bubble scatter with trails.

items.title: Implement Template 8: DistributionHistogram + Pre-Baked 4K60 Ambient Motion Backgrounds
items.acceptance_criteria: Bell-curve percentile visualizer + 3 reusable 4K60 subtle dark-mode animated backdrop loops.

items.title: Build Scene Concatenator, Master Audio-Video Muxer & YouTube 4K60 Export Preset
items.acceptance_criteria: Assembles full 10-18 min 4K60 MP4 with faststart atom, 0ms AV drift, and verified playback in VLC/YouTube. Master export defaults to a 1440p60 preset at ~12-16 Mbps; the 4K60 preset is REN-10 (D-12).

items.title: Build the 60s Shorts hook extractor (climax clip, burned captions, long-form link)
items.acceptance_criteria: Renders a 9:16 60s cut from the episode's strongest DataBrief contrast with burned captions and uploads it as a Short carrying the long-form link in the description; long-form click-through per Short is logged in SQLite. Profit Multiplier 4 is worth $4.20-$10.50 per episode at $10.50 RPM, earned over the Short's lifetime rather than per day.

items.title: Add the 4K60 (3840x2160) preset to the render engine once the channel is monetized
items.acceptance_criteria: The engine renders 3840x2160 at 60fps through the same NVENC pipe with no code path change beyond the preset, and the upgrade is applied to the top-performing episodes before new output. Gated behind YPP approval (DECISIONS.md D-12): 4K60 is 2.2x the pixels, render time and bitrate budget of 1440p60, and the repository holds no evidence that resolution moves CTR or retention for static data charts.

items.title: Build Playwright HTML/SVG -> 1920x1080 PNG Thumbnail Factory (3 distinct CTR templates)
items.acceptance_criteria: Generates 3 distinct variants (Map Contrast, Flag Showdown, Outlier Spike) per episode in <10s.

items.title: Add Mobile-Scale Legibility Preview (168x94px grid) & Contrast Ratio Checker
items.acceptance_criteria: Produces a 3-variant contact sheet at mobile thumbnail size and flags text contrast below WCAG AA.

items.title: Build Automated QC Suite (ffprobe spec check, blackdetect, freezedetect, silence, LUFS, layout overlap)
items.acceptance_criteria: Outputs pass/fail QC JSON report; blocks publishing automatically on any spec violation or audio/video defect.

items.title: Build Telegram (or Discord) Mobile Approval Bot with 30s hook clip, thumbnails & one-tap commands
items.acceptance_criteria: Sends episode review bundle to phone; supports /approve, /regen_thumb, /fix_scene <n>, and /hold commands.

items.title: Configure Google Cloud OAuth & YouTube Data API v3 Resumable Uploader (chapters + scheduling)
items.acceptance_criteria: Uploads 4K60 master as scheduled video at optimal Tier-1 UTC slot with chapter timestamps and custom thumbnail.

items.title: Build Automated Metadata & SRT Subtitle Localizer (German, French, Japanese revenue set)
items.acceptance_criteria: Translates title and description into de, fr and ja and uploads accurate time-coded SRTs for those three via YouTube localizations and captions APIs; ships es-419/pt-BR/hi captions only (reach, no revenue claim) and no ar. A market only receives localized metadata once captions in that language ship in the same commit - a German title over English audio is a negative-EV bounce (DECISIONS.md D-05). The language list is config (config/languages.json), not code.

items.title: Build Facebook In-Stream Cut Generator (3s visual hook + burned captions) & Graph API Uploader
items.acceptance_criteria: Eligibility is confirmed on the actual Page before any render code is written (DECISIONS.md D-06); once eligible, renders an FB-ready MP4 with high-contrast burned captions and uploads it on a schedule. If the program is not open to the Page, the item is closed as not-applicable and the Facebook revenue line is dropped from the model rather than assumed.

items.title: Build the ancillary revenue lane: per-episode dataset page, SVG chart exports and an embeddable feed
items.acceptance_criteria: Every episode publishes a dataset page (CSV, chart SVGs, methodology note, source citation) on a static site plus an embeddable feed, and external-traffic watch-time share is logged in SQLite. Profit Multiplier 5 is the $330-$440/day ancillary line at the goal, so this lane is instrumented from the first episode instead of assumed.

items.title: Build session bridging: playlist/series slots, end-screen bridge to one named next video, pinned comment
items.acceptance_criteria: Every upload lands in a pillar playlist, its end screen points at one named next episode rather than a subscribe prompt, and the pinned comment carries the chapter list plus the dataset link. Session-time and views-per-viewer from Browse/Suggested are logged in SQLite so the effect is measurable rather than assumed; session duration is the channel-level signal that decides the next upload's impressions (VIEW_OPTIMIZATION sections 5 and 6).

items.title: Build Resumable Episode DAG Orchestrator (SQLite state machine with scene-level checkpointing)
items.acceptance_criteria: Single CLI command `python -m src.orchestrator run <episode_id>` runs end-to-end and resumes cleanly from any crash. Artifacts use one layout, data/episodes/<episode_id>/<stage>/<content_hash>.<ext>, which is what makes resume and retry-after-edit cheap: a stage is skipped when its key file already exists.

items.title: Configure Daily Autonomous Cron / Systemd Timer for the 1/day production cadence
items.acceptance_criteria: Automatically builds next queued episode overnight IST so approval bundle arrives every morning at 08:00 IST. The cron is enabled only after the VAL-01 14-day read, so automation never multiplies an unvalidated format.

items.title: Create Flagship YouTube Channel & Facebook Page (branding, banner, about, Tier-1 English positioning)
items.acceptance_criteria: Channel branded as authoritative global data documentary network; verification enabled for custom thumbnails & >15 min uploads.

items.title: Implement Anti-Demonetization Policy Checklist & Citation/License Audit Manifest
items.acceptance_criteria: Every episode ships with persistent source overlays, >=5 unique visual templates, analytical commentary, and verified asset licenses.

items.title: Apply for YouTube Partner Program (1k subs + 4k watch hrs) & Facebook In-Stream Monetization
items.acceptance_criteria: Both YouTube AdSense and Facebook In-Stream approved with clean policy standing and mid-roll ads enabled.

items.title: Complete India USD Payout & Tax Optimization (AdSense SWIFT, US Form W-8BEN 15% DTAA, GST LUT prep)
items.acceptance_criteria: W-8BEN approved (15% US withholding vs 24%/30%), Indian bank SWIFT USD settlement tested, e-FIRA workflow documented.

items.title: Write the docs/compliance/W8BEN_CHECKLIST.md filing artifact that CMP-04 executes
items.acceptance_criteria: docs/compliance/W8BEN_CHECKLIST.md exists with the step-by-step AdSense tax-info filing for India (W-8BEN, 15% DTAA rate vs 24%/30%), GST registration plus LUT, and the e-FIRA archival workflow. Profit Multiplier 7 is $70/day of AdSense retained at the goal, so the artifact ships before the first payout cycle rather than after it.

items.title: Build YouTube Analytics & Revenue daily ETL into SQLite (CTR, AVD, RPM, retention curves, geo)
items.acceptance_criteria: Daily cron ingests video-level performance and geo RPM splits (US/UK/CA/AU share) into SQLite.

items.title: Build Retention Drop-Off Diagnostic & RPM-per-Topic Feedback Loop
items.acceptance_criteria: Weekly Telegram report correlates >3% retention drops to exact scene templates and updates topic scorer weights.

items.title: Build Automated Annual Dataset Refresh Trigger ('2027/2028 Edition' re-render pipeline)
items.acceptance_criteria: Detects new World Bank / OECD annual releases and queues refreshed sequel episodes for top-earning evergreen videos.

items.title: Add Multi-Channel Config Isolation & Multi-Language Audio Dubbing (YouTube MLA for de/fr/ja)
items.acceptance_criteria: Single GPU pipeline serves 3+ niche channels via channel_id configs and optional de/fr/ja audio tracks, priced at the PPM_REVIEW.md sec.0 revenue-set blend.

items.title: Run the first refresh wave: re-master and re-release the top 10 episodes when their datasets update
items.acceptance_criteria: The ten best-performing episodes are re-rendered with refreshed source rows and re-released (same video where YouTube permits an update, new episode where the dataset changed materially), with a recorded views delta at day 28 per episode. A refresh adds views without adding library, so it is the only lever that raises views/video/day with no dilution (DECISIONS.md D-10); ANA-03 automates this trigger later, ANA-05 proves it once by hand.
